bullets: 💡 LOCAL BLUETOOTH CONTROL: Control two independent lighting circuits by touch from one smooth glass touch panel or from the Smart Life app while you are at home. No hub or router is needed for local Bluetooth control.

💡 HUB REQUIRED FOR REMOTE AND VOICE FEATURES — Add the Hauza Hub (sold separately) for remote access, schedules, scenes, voice assistants, Home Assistant and multi-control association by software. Up to 128 Hauza switches and other Tuya BLE devices by Hub.

💡 MULTI-CONTROL ASSOCIATION: To control 2 or more switches in your home, simply associate them at "Smart Life" App. There is no need of a conventional traveler-wire 3-way wiring. 💡 NEUTRAL WIRING REQUIRED: Hauza switches require Neutral connection. Best performance, to avoid any flickering-especially for external driver light fixtures. Compatible even for low-power LED lights, starting from just 5 watts

💡COMPATIBLE WITH TUYA: Hauza switches live naturally in "Smart Life" or "Tuya" Apps. There is no need to add another App to your Smartphone. Include Hauza switches into your current Routines to enjoy smart lighting.

💡STANDARD DIMENSIONS: Designed to fit current electrical boxes in the USA. Switch dimensions without front cover - Width x Height x Depth: 2.64 x 4.45 x 1.22 in. Confirm your electrical box size prior to purchasing

💡 DIFFERENTIATED DESIGN: In a market full of look-alike products, Hauza smart switches were crafted for homeowners who value both innovation and aesthetics. The minimalist geometry, subtle curves, and premium finish combine smart control with a sleek, minimalist style that instantly upgrades every room to feel more refined.
